[LERR.1.3.7] **Shape.** The expression reads as `null` and
propagates under Kleene ([LNUL.4.1]); the rule
fires only on `true` ([LNUL.4.3]), so it does not
fire. No fact is
asserted and the activation continues. No sentinel
is produced: nothing takes part in further
computation as though it were data. An absence
raises no fault, so no metric counts it and the
engine writes no log entry for it.
